video_title: Fan Hot Takes: Garbage Time Spida, Aday Mara Soaring, Matas Buzelis Slumping

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell's performance in losing game situations
quotes.excerpt: Once we start losing, Donovan Mitchell just becomes Spider-Man. Now you want to shoot webs and shit.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I see what he's saying. He's saying once we start losing, Donovan Mitchell just becomes Spider-Man. Now you want to shoot webs and shit. He likes if you started off shooting webs, they never get close.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: He's that type of player where it's like, he can hurt you in a normal situation, normal game situation, especially if the game is tight, because sometimes, like you actually said, it'd be like, 'Bro, what are you doing?'

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Why Donovan Mitchell's intense workout habits look insane in-game
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes players that work that hard, to us it looks insane, but their workout calls for it.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: He thinks everything. It's like he drills so much stuff. Sometimes players that work that hard, to us it looks insane, but their workout calls for it. If I come off here, this guy's here, I gotta do this, step around this defender, and then the floater. If you drill that shit over and over and over in the game, yeah, to everybody else it's like, 'Bro, just pass it.'

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: But it's like you're dribbling with your head down in a circle, and you're looking, driving past people who are open and shooting the worst shot possible, or shooting an airball, honestly.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell and Giannis Antetokounmpo as high-usage weapons
quotes.excerpt: Players like Donovan Mitchell aren't really serviceable, so it's really hard to see their value on paper.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Players like Donovan Mitchell aren't really serviceable, so it's really hard to see their value on paper, but they are a weapon. It's like the Giannis situation where it's like, man, yes, this might not be serviceable in a normal situation, but there are situations where we're going to need this.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Yeah, like when we go down. And people don't want to squeeze the trigger. It's like, get him the ball, he'll shoot it 20 straight times. It will adjust, we'll just adjust from there too. And if he starts making, he'll bring us right back.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell's role with James Harden on the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I feel like Donovan did better last year when he had the other guys playing point guard.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I feel like Donovan did better last year when he had the other guys playing point guard before James got there, because they were better with setting him up in a traditional way. James still sets people up, it's just not traditional from a point guard.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: And you don't know when you're going to get the ball. There's a lot of times where it's like, you know you're going to get the ball, but you don't know when or where.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Aday Mara's impressive performance and development
quotes.excerpt: He is hooping and he not looking back. He not worried about foul trouble.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Aday Mara's got me smiling like a proud father. Meanwhile, OKC is operating like, 'What injuries?' And also Aday Mara got me smiling like a proud father. Yes, he does. Yes, he does.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: He is hooping and he not looking back. He not worried about foul trouble. He not worried about making mistakes. He and everybody face, he doesn't look like a rookie. I'm gonna just say that. He doesn't look like a rookie.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Michigan's team chemistry and professional approach
quotes.excerpt: Michigan now shows and improves what type of team they had because you're seeing guys there.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Michigan now shows and improves what type of team they had because you're seeing guys there, they're just plug and play. They handle responsibility well. Yaxel is older, yes, but their brand of basketball that they were playing over there, as well as the coaching that was provided for them, I think they handle themselves like true professionals.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Aday Mara, there's times that, you know, he's still very raw in the sense of the NBA game that we're talking about, but you'll never catch him not rim running. You'll never catch him not making the effort to box out.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Matas Buzelis's struggles against the Knicks' defense
quotes.excerpt: Buzelis is 6'8", should be killing those guys. It didn't happen.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Knicks threw some of their weakest defenders on Matas Buzelis last night. Jalen Brunson was his primary defender. Also guarded by Dalton Knecht, Jordan Clarkson, Tyler Kolek, among others. Buzelis is 6'8", should be killing those guys. It didn't happen.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I don't know how to diagnose his game so far, just because I've expected so much just based off of what we saw last year. I don't know exactly what's wrong with Buzelis.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: The challenge of integrating similar-sized players in a rotation
quotes.excerpt: They all got similar builds. It's the 6'8", 6'9" athletic guy.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Caleb Wilson is over there now. They trying to feature him. They all got similar builds. It's the 6'8", 6'9" athletic guy. It's like, if Kevin Durant saw Kevin Durant walk in, they'd both be like, 'Weirded out.' Fuck you go get Kevin Durant, Chet, and the Giannis. They're going to be like, 'Okay, where who's playing where?'

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: You get what I mean? And that's what I feel like is happening right now. They're just, they're all similar, they trying to figure out what's going to be my rotation.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating Matas Buzelis's height and skill level
quotes.excerpt: He just asked the question though. He's just saying this dude 6'8" he towering over everybody.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: He just asked the question though. He's just saying this dude 6'8" he towering over everybody who we just named, shouldn't he be killing them?

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: No, he taller and skilled. Like he should be, I mean, Tyler Kolek, like you should have been putting him in the bucket at least.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Critique of the Knicks' defensive assignments on Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I'm just saying we can't be letting them put Jalen Brunson on them primarily most of the game.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I'm just saying we can't be letting them put Jalen Brunson on them primarily most of the game and then, you know, that's just cool. You see what I'm saying? It's just, just do it for us for the normal guys.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I ain't gonna lie, Zelly, I'll say this, Zelly. This is a little disrespectful.
